build_geometry_module: build a GeometryModule from mesh vertex indices, UV coords, and face topology to render index images
create_uv_face_index: create a UV-space face index map that identifies which mesh face contains each texel
compute_barycentric_coords: compute barycentric coordinates for 2D query points within their enclosing triangles
project_3d_points: project a set of 3D points into multiple cameras using a pinhole model with extrinsics and intrinsics
compute_vertex_normals: compute vertex normals from mesh geometry by averaging adjacent face normals
